uses_memory_ids: memory_b2 (regional failover during March degradation, traffic shifted cleanly and error rates recovered within minutes)
memory_b5 (routing report queries to read replicas took dashboard load off primary, transactional write latency recovered same day)
answer.rationale: Both memories show regional failover and read-replica routing successfully stabilized latency under heavy write/peak traffic conditions. The current failure is p99 latency on write path confined to primary region, peak settlement traffic, and a recent release. Failover to a healthy region would isolate the degraded primary and preserve writes, while read-replica routing could offload read pressure if write latency persists post-failover. Applying both patterns in sequence (failover first, then replica routing) maximizes sustained availability without losing customer writes.
